note: Rows the maintainers ran on a newer harness than the earlier rows. Each is ranked in the table of the Short suite version it ran, keeps that model's earlier row in the earlier set and moves no other row. report is a verified report, and report_sha256 pins it. runs is the run folder the report was packed from, which gives the cost and the harness. replaced maps a kept earlier attempt folder to the reason it was run again. These paths are relative to the data folder, or to the folder of the row's root when it names one. The build is given that folder as --root NAME=FOLDER, so this file holds no absolute path, and a row whose root is not given is left off the site. A row is shown only when the report, its hash and the run folder all agree with the stored Short suite.
